questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8ed9d533393e893e27117c66bed816e3f7476a507b083daabd3862473bc5c87.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• When an equal digit/letter is on an equal surface, the remaining equal surface are opposite each other. 
 
• When no common numbers/symbols in 2 dices, the equal surface is opposite to each other .

For this question, the relation is given below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1202bc9560c7f367a6755eb9ae3d7c1ca2eabafcf320a5891a69b3710875eee7.png] 

In first and third dice, which is shown above, faces A and B are common, which means E is the face opposite to F.

Hence, ‘**F**’ is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dices are of two types :

 
• Standard Dice
 
• Non-Standard Dice.

 
• Dice has:-

 
• faces = 6
 
• sides = 12
 
• corners = 8

 
• Two opposite faces are never seen together.
 
• Adjacent faces are never opposite to each other.

questions.solution:
When comparing figures 1 and 2, we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98beed1dfb35f9001aea014fa3f1e5af54e7a896cc22d7b3e81bae6869e7d85d.png] 

When '1' and '6' are visible in both dices, we get '5' and '2' are opposite to each other.

Now we compare figures 2 and 3, we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/403e05a41dbefe7956aff12721ed6aae18460062d1a73983ed141975c950be45.png] 

When '1' and '2' are visible in both dices, we get **'4' and '6' are opposite to each other.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
